title.zh: 将宿务市Abellana国立职业学校的名称正式变更为Abellana国立学校的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Abellana National Vocational School in the City of Cebu to Abellana National School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Abellana National Vocational School in the City of Cebu to Abellana National School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Abellana National Vocational School tại Thành phố Cebu thành Abellana National School
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ Abellana National Vocational School ในเมือง Cebu เป็น Abellana National School
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Abellana National Vocational School di Kota Cebu menjadi Abellana National School
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Abellana National Vocational School di Bandaraya Cebu menjadi Abellana National School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1961/ra_3027_1961.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Abellana National Vocational School in the City of Cebu is hereby changed to Abellana National School. General courses as well as vocational courses shall be offered in said school.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 7, 1961.
